description.value:
Your experience surviving harrowing environments allows you to bolster your allies in addition to yourself. When you finish a Short Rest, you can choose a number of creatures you can see equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one). A chosen creature regains Hit Points equal to 1d10 plus your Ranger level and has Advantage on Constitution Saving Throws and Wisdom Saving Throws to avoid or end the Frightened condition for 24 hours.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.
